agent_event_kind.Provider: Use ProviderEvent disposition, retaining agent identity. Child preview/status stays attributed to the child and does not join the root answer.
agent_event_kind.Subagent: Retain Started/Completed with descriptor, identity, usage and evidenced result/error; update existing child status. No new control authority.
agent_event_kind.Message: Retain Sent/Delivered attribution, recipient/kind/router sequence when supplied; unsequenced remains unsequenced.
agent_event_kind.McpChannel: Retain external source/content framing, escaped as data; never classify as operator slash input.
agent_event_kind.UsageEstimate: Update estimate state explicitly marked estimated; distinguish cumulative usage from current-turn deltas.
agent_event_kind.StreamRetry: Retain wait/error class and attempt state; invalidate only affected provisional attempt, never committed calls/results.
agent_event_kind.Compaction: Retain local summary/state and reconcile the committed Compaction event when available; no duplicate pretend assistant answer.

provider_event.ResponseStreamEvent: Observability-only envelope; not a generic raw transcript body. Do not expose provider transport state by expanding tools.
provider_event.ResponseAudioFrame: Audio observability/persistence lane; no raw audio bytes or fabricated text displayed. Existing text-transcript projections are handled through their actual semantic source.
provider_event.TextDelta: Append to attempt-local ordered provisional text segment.
provider_event.RefusalDelta: Append refusal preview by actual item/output/content identity; remain a refusal, not provider error.
provider_event.RefusalComplete: Replace exact refusal preview, do not append duplicate text.
provider_event.ThinkingDelta: Append exposed display reasoning summary only; obey display toggle.
provider_event.ToolCallDelta: Retain item_id/call_id alias and kind, original raw argument fragments; partial JSON need not parse.
provider_event.TextComplete: Replace matching provisional text content; never append a second answer.
provider_event.ThinkingComplete: Replace matching summary preview; no encrypted reasoning body.
provider_event.ReasoningItemDone: Provider replay item: expose approved human-readable summary only if not already present; encrypted_content never enters display references.
provider_event.ResponseItemDone: Authoritative provider item completion, still provisional until store acceptance. Project approved item parts with stable provider IDs and avoid flat-field duplicates.
provider_event.ToolCallComplete: Finalize call_id/name/kind/raw arguments and preserve description after completion.
provider_event.ToolResult: Join exact call and retain full result reference/duration; extract evidence states independently from error.
provider_event.Compaction: Opaque provider compaction metadata only; encrypted payload is not display text. Different from AgentEventKind::Compaction summary.
provider_event.Done: End response iteration/usage/stop reason; tool results can still follow. Do not finalize pending calls as fake null results.
provider_event.Error: Retain visible typed error and incomplete state; reconcile final step error without text-equality dedup.

session_event.UserMessage: Committed operator/injected message event; origin comes from explicit source association, not string decoration or leading slash. Unknown legacy origin remains unspecified.
session_event.AssistantMessage: response_items is authoritative when present; otherwise approved content/thinking/tool_calls projection. Retain refusal/stop state and usage references.
session_event.SpokenResponse: Validated structured content with primary/secondary view using the same stored value.
session_event.ToolResult: Committed call output/duration/spool reference; demand invocation correlation if outside the page.
session_event.ModelChange: Historical old/new model transition; no mutation on selection.
session_event.ProviderEpochBoundary: Semantic boundary reason; no raw provider state.
session_event.Compaction: Committed summary/affected IDs remain audit history; never replace visible history with provider prompt projection.
session_event.ChildBranch: Actual structural child/session/parent-anchor provenance; absent child session stays ephemeral.
session_event.ForkComplete: Child completion reference and approved validated result details, preserving child identity.
session_event.Label: Named label/description item.
session_event.Custom: Retain event_type and source identity; display only approved content fields for known custom types. Unknown payload is unavailable pending explicit policy, not a raw dump of internal provider state.
session_event.ContextMark: Context bookkeeping status by target ID; not an injected new assistant answer.
session_event.RuleInjection: Rule/content with explicit source and trust framing, never instructions to the UI.

producer_sites.obligation: write_user_message, submitted turn, queued follow-up, root inbound and MCP idle wake; retain display/admission/delivery distinction and no synthetic empty prompt
mark delivered only from ActiveInputDelivery; retain pending/queued/cancel state and draft semantics
render_child_result_batch currently calls write_user_message; store as child result attribution while keeping secure frame queue untouched
text/thinking flush/partial tools/error tail; pending arguments must survive result completion
all AgentEvent/ProviderEvent dispositions including root/child split, retry, compaction, channel, estimates
Completed/Refused/SchemaUnreachable/MaxIterationsReached/Cancelled/TimedOut/Truncated and errors, without inventing provider success
help/tool/skill lists, new/compact status, unavailable/failed operations and notices remain retained
model/effort/service-tier/fast usage, validation refusal, effective selection confirmations

MCP command start/busy/complete/fail lines and output remain retained. NCS policy is immutable for this launch; reload applies that policy to new definitions. Display existing refusals honestly; do not invent live channel-policy editing.
startup partial-history notice, /new identity and saved-event rendering; do not claim existing tab helper is wired navigation
current model/usage/context, running/waiting/retry status, child rows, pending input; no permanently empty status strip
all SessionEvent variants and primary/secondary/thinking views migrate without hiding errors or duplicating response projections
startup capability/I/O/guard failures remain typed; errors after terminal restoration may go to caller stderr, never into a phantom retained item

Preserve existing pre-construction resolved channel-mode validation. R3 additionally threads the assembled owner SessionBinding into TuiInputs; missing infra errors explicitly. No TUI provider/MCP is built for an invalid resolved channel mode.
producer_sites.owner_row: R3 actual binding wiring only; R7 launch-order acceptance

review_note: Unknown typed enum variants require a new exhaustive disposition. Unknown Custom payloads are not automatically safe display bodies. This inventory distinguishes current semantic content from observability-only data.

ncs_delta.driver_change: Validate resolved channel mode before constructing provider/MCP in TUI launch.

response_item.Message: Project approved visible text/refusal parts in order; no duplicate flat assistant rendering.
response_item.Reasoning: Expose approved display summary only; opaque/encrypted reasoning remains outside body capabilities.
response_item.FunctionCall: Correlate canonical call_id, name and function arguments.
response_item.CustomToolCall: Preserve raw freeform input and call kind.
response_item.WebSearchCall: Show typed activity/identity only, not unapproved raw fields.
response_item.Compaction: Show provider compaction identity/status; encrypted payload is excluded.
response_item.Known: Keep known typed item identity/kind; only specifically approved display fields are exposed.
response_item.Opaque: Keep discriminator/identity with unavailable display body; never discard identity or expose arbitrary raw payload.
